scope: G02 native file availability recovery and confirmed relocation; no app build/restart or native GUI validation in this pass

checks.scope: Final complete-readable readonly candidate correction; original files_workflow suite was not repeated.

verifiedBehaviors: Broken symlink initial open returns owner-validated FileRef in error details; retry opens same identity after target returns; cross-project and unknown IDs disclose no FileRef.
Deleted source retains mark_dirty/checkpoint/save_as/close workflows without recreating original path; ordinary save remains conditional and refuses vanished source.
Real EACCES remains PERMISSION_DENIED with retained identity; metadata-only draft writes remain available.
Real native filesystem deletion events invalidate both open documents; clean stays clean and dirty stays dirty.
Prepare grants no external access; confirmed association grants selected external file only, never its directory/sibling; keepBuffer is unavailable without a dirty buffer.

Keep buffer uses full checkpoint beyond the 256 KiB candidate preview, preserves document ID/revision/encoding/EOL/selection/state, rebinds checkpoint and base revision, survives HostState restart, writes target only on later explicit save.
Explicit useSelected loads candidate before replacing native state and removing old checkpoint; leaves both source/target disk bytes unchanged.
Candidate disk changes and source editor changes reject stale confirmation while retaining original checkpoint and association.

Another opened native document rejects relocation. keepBuffer rejects mixed-EOL/UTF16/binary/long-line simplified candidates. Unsupported/incomplete candidates reject useSelected for dirty buffers; complete readable 0444 text permits explicit useSelected, removes old checkpoint only after opening, and preserves source/target disk revisions plus readonly permissions.
Project epoch, project identity and digest are rechecked before association.
